# Vyoma Studio

A premium, engineering-driven agency website built with Astro, featuring smooth GSAP animations, modern design, and high-performance architecture.

![Vyoma Studio](https://img.shields.io/badge/Vyoma-Studio-000000?style=for-the-badge)
![Astro](https://img.shields.io/badge/Astro-5.16-BC52EE?style=for-the-badge&logo=astro)
![GSAP](https://img.shields.io/badge/GSAP-3.14-88CE02?style=for-the-badge)

## ✨ Features

- **Premium Preloader** — Elegant text reveal animation with smooth transitions
- **Hero Section** — Full-screen background with staggered content animations
- **Smooth Scrolling** — Lenis smooth scroll integrated with GSAP ScrollTrigger
- **Dark/Light Sections** — Strategic use of dark sections for visual rhythm
- **Tech Stack Marquee** — Infinite scrolling logos with hover pause
- **Video CTA** — Gradient video background for call-to-action section
- **Bento Grid Layout** — Modern "Why Us" section with animated cards
- **Timeline Process** — Animated vertical timeline with scroll-triggered reveals
- **Large Footer Branding** — Oversized brand text in footer

## 🛠️ Tech Stack

- **Framework:** [Astro](https://astro.build/) v5
- **Animation:** [GSAP](https://greensock.com/gsap/) with ScrollTrigger
- **Smooth Scroll:** [Lenis](https://github.com/studio-freight/lenis)
- **Styling:** Tailwind CSS + Custom CSS Variables
- **Fonts:** Inter, Mona Sans (via Fontsource)
- **React:** For interactive components

## 📁 Project Structure

```
src/
├── assets/
│   ├── images/          # Tech stack logos (SVG)
│   ├── videos/          # Background videos
│   └── background-image.jpg
├── components/
│   ├── Header.astro     # Sticky navbar with glass effect
│   ├── Hero.astro       # Full-screen hero with animations
│   ├── Services.astro   # Service cards grid
│   ├── SelectedWork.astro # Portfolio with 3D card effects
│   ├── WhyUs.astro      # Dark bento grid section
│   ├── HowWeWork.astro  # Animated timeline
│   ├── TechStack.astro  # Dark marquee section
│   ├── CallToAction.astro # Video background CTA
│   ├── Footer.astro     # Dark footer with large brand text
│   └── Preloader.astro  # Premium loading animation
├── layouts/
│   └── Layout.astro     # Base layout with Lenis setup
├── pages/
│   ├── index.astro      # Homepage
│   ├── about.astro
│   ├── contact.astro
│   └── work.astro
└── styles/
    └── global.css       # CSS variables & global styles
```

## 🚀 Getting Started

```bash
# Install dependencies
npm install

# Start development server
npm run dev

# Build for production
npm run build

# Preview production build
npm run preview
```

## 🎨 Design System

### Colors
```css
--color-bg: #FFFFFF
--color-bg-secondary: #FAFAFA
--color-accent: #000000
--color-text: #000000
--color-text-muted: #52525B
```

### Dark Sections
The Why Us and Tech Stack sections use inverted colors:
```css
background-color: #09090b
```

## 📦 Key Dependencies

| Package | Purpose |
|---------|---------|
| `astro` | Static site framework |
| `gsap` | Animation library |
| `@studio-freight/lenis` | Smooth scrolling |
| `tailwindcss` | Utility-first CSS |
| `@fontsource/*` | Self-hosted fonts |

## 🔧 Scripts

| Command | Action |
|---------|--------|
| `npm run dev` | Start dev server at `localhost:4321` |
| `npm run build` | Build production site to `./dist/` |
| `npm run preview` | Preview production build locally |

summary: Project-Vyoma is a premium, engineering-driven agency website built using the Astro framework, showcasing smooth GSAP animations, modern design, and high-performance architecture. This project is ideal for businesses seeking to establish a sophisticated online presence that stands out from competitors. Its key features include a premium preloader, hero section with full-screen background, smooth scrolling, dark/light sections, a tech stack marquee, gradient video CTA, Bento grid layout, animated vertical timeline, and large footer branding. These elements combine to deliver an engaging user experience and visually appealing design.
architecture:
1. The overall structure of Project-Vyoma is organized around the typical front-end web development layout, with a clear separation between static assets and source code. The root directory contains essential configuration files (.gitignore, .vscode, README.md, astro.config.mjs, package-lock.json, package.json) and public assets like images, SVGs, and videos. These static assets are crucial for enhancing user experience through visual appeal.

2. The src directory holds all the source code, divided into two main subdirectories: assets and components. The assets directory stores reusable image, SVG, video files, and background elements necessary for the application's visual design. Meanwhile, the components directory contains the core building blocks of the application, implemented using Astro (v3) and React (via @astrojs/react). Each component is an independent, self-contained piece of functionality that can be composed together to create complex UI structures. For instance, the AnnouncementBar.astro and CallToAction.astro components could be combined to form a custom announcement bar on the dashboard.

3. Several key architectural patterns are employed in this project. Firstly, the component-based architecture allows for modularity, maintainability, and reusability of code. Each component is encapsulated, with its own props, state management, and rendering logic. This pattern simplifies the development process by breaking down the application into smaller, more manageable pieces. Secondly, the use of Astro as the primary framework enables server-side rendering (SSR) and static site generation (SSG). SSR improves initial load times and SEO, while SSG ensures fast subsequent page loads and reduces server load. Lastly, TypeScript is utilized throughout the codebase, providing strong typing, autocompletion, and type checking, which ultimately leads to fewer runtime errors and better overall code quality.
